title: Grammar Range: Simple to Complex
focus: Combinar orações e controlar precisão gramatical
verifiableTask: Transformar seis sentenças em estruturas complexas corretas

content.text: Ao final da aula você consegue:
combinar frases simples usando orações relativas, condicionais, conectores de contraste/causa e voz passiva.
transformar seis sentenças em estruturas complexas corretas.
Junte as duas frases em uma, falando:
I live in São Paulo. It is a very big city.
I live in São Paulo, which is a very big city.
It was raining. We went to the beach.
I study hard. I want to get a 7.
Although it is expensive, it is worth it.
If governments invested more, schools would improve.
Pausa natural antes da oração extra:
My city, | which is on the coast, | is very hot.
Although the city is expensive, it is popular with students, who come from all over the country.

questions.questionText: I live in São Paulo, ______ is a very big city. (pronome relativo para coisa/lugar com vírgula)

explanations.general: I live in São Paulo, which is a very big city.

questions.questionText: Which is a correct passive sentence?

options.text: The bridge was built in 1990.
The bridge was build in 1990.
The bridge built in 1990.

explanations.general: Correct answer: The bridge was built in 1990.

questions.questionText: If governments invested more, schools ______ improve. (2ª condicional)

explanations.general: If governments invested more, schools would improve.

options.text: since
whereas
therefore

questions.questionText: ______ a language takes time. (learn → sujeito com -ing)

options.text: Although it rained, we went out.
Although, it rained we went out.

explanations.A: Vírgula depois da oração com although.
explanations.general: Correct answer: Although it rained, we went out.

content.text: vale mais que uma frase gigante com erros. Regra prática para Writing:
Many people move to cities. They want jobs. Cities become crowded. Housing becomes expensive.
jobs in smaller towns, fewer people
Fale junto com o professor e marque cada ferramenta usada (causa, resultado, relativa, condicional).
→ People / live near parks / are healthier → Cities / have good public transport / have less traffic → Countries / invest in education / grow faster
People speak English all over the world.
The government built a new hospital last year.
Factories produce millions of plastic bottles every day.
If children spend too much time online, ______
If I could change one thing in my city, ______

questions.questionText: People ______ live near parks are healthier. (relativo para pessoas)

explanations.general: People who live near parks are healthier.

questions.questionText: English ______ spoken all over the world. (passiva, presente)

explanations.general: English is spoken all over the world.

questions.questionText: Passive: “The government built a new hospital last year.”

options.text: A new hospital was built by the government last year.
A new hospital is built last year.
A new hospital built by the government.

explanations.general: Correct answer: A new hospital was built by the government last year.

questions.questionText: New vaccines are ______ developed by scientists. (passiva contínua)

explanations.general: New vaccines are being developed by scientists.

options.text: If public transport is free, more people would use it.
If public transport were free, more people would use it.
If public transport would be free, more people use it.

explanations.general: Correct answer: If public transport were free, more people would use it.

questions.questionText: Which sentence is complex AND correct?

options.text: Cities that have good public transport usually have less traffic.
Cities that has good public transport usually have less traffic.
Cities have good public transport have less traffic.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Cities that have good public transport usually have less traffic.

content.text: Junte/transforme usando a ferramenta indicada. Revise a precisão.
(relativa) The museum is very old. It was renovated last year.
(contraste) Online courses are cheap. Many students prefer face-to-face classes.
(causa/resultado) Fuel prices increased. Many people started cycling.
(2ª condicional) Governments don't tax sugary drinks. People drink too much sugar.
(passiva) Companies collect a lot of personal data.
(gerúndio sujeito) You exercise regularly. It improves your mood.
O aluno lê. O professor marca erros de precisão (concordância, tempo, pontuação). O aluno corrige.
Responda em 45 s usando 3 estruturas complexas:
Why do people move from the countryside to cities?
[ ] As 6 frases estão corretas e com a estrutura pedida?
[ ] Na fala, usou pelo menos 2 frases complexas?
Escreva 6 frases sobre sua cidade com
Escreva 6 frases passivas sobre como algo é feito (café, pão, um celular).
Escreva 6 frases sobre problemas sociais com 1ª e 2ª condicional.
Reescreva o modelo “simples” de um tema seu (4 frases simples → 2 complexas).
Should the government make public transport free?
Escreva 100 palavras sobre o tema do dia 5 com pelo menos 4 frases complexas. Revise.

questions.questionText: Join: “The museum is very old. It was renovated last year.”

options.text: The museum, which is very old, was renovated last year.
The museum who is very old was renovated last year.
The museum is very old, it was renovated last year.

explanations.general: Correct answer: The museum, which is very old, was renovated last year.

questions.questionText: Join with contrast: “Online courses are cheap. Many students prefer face-to-face classes.”

options.text: Although online courses are cheap, many students prefer face-to-face classes.
Because online courses are cheap, many students prefer face-to-face classes.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Although online courses are cheap, many students prefer face-to-face classes.

questions.questionText: Fuel prices increased; ______, many people started cycling. (como resultado)

explanations.general: Fuel prices increased; therefore, many people started cycling.

questions.questionText: Passive: “Companies collect a lot of personal data.”

options.text: A lot of personal data is collected by companies.
A lot of personal data collected by companies.
A lot of personal data is collect by companies.

explanations.general: Correct answer: A lot of personal data is collected by companies.

questions.questionText: ______ regularly improves your mood. (exercise → sujeito com -ing)
To get a higher grammar score, every sentence must be very long and complex.

options.text: True
False

explanations.general: Falso: misture frases simples e complexas, sempre com precisão.

content.text: 1 English is spoken all over the world. 2 A new hospital was built (by the government) last year. 3 Millions of plastic bottles are produced every day. 4 New vaccines are being developed.

1 The museum, which is very old, was renovated last year. 2 Although online courses are cheap, many students prefer face-to-face classes. 3 Fuel prices increased, so many people started cycling. 4 If governments taxed sugary drinks, people would drink less sugar. 5 A lot of personal data is collected by companies. 6 Exercising regularly improves your mood.
